source.description: First 10 entries (count 0-9) of the official CRYSTALS-Kyber round-3 known-answer test file for Kyber1024 (non-90s variant), copied byte-for-byte except that hex is lowercased. Field mapping: seed = 48-byte DRBG seed; public_key = pk (1568 bytes, raw, no libsignal type byte); secret_key = sk (3168 bytes, expanded form); ciphertext = ct (1568 bytes, raw); shared_secret = ss (32 bytes). libsignal 0.99.1 serializes these with a leading 0x08 type byte (see spec/crypto/kem.md).
source.submission_version: CRYSTALS-Kyber NIST round-3 submission package dated 2020-10-01 (spec v3.0)
source.cross_check: SHA3-256 of pk/sk/ct and ss for all 100 entries equal libcrux-ml-kem v0.0.10 tests/kats/nistkats_kyber_1024.json (https://github.com/celabshq/libcrux @ c5fb80f37530ee9b2df9501ae5ff8cb4a973a4bd, tag libcrux-ml-kem-v0.0.10), which is the Kyber implementation linked into libsignal v0.99.1. The identical file also ships at NIST-PQ-Submission-Kyber-20201001/Additional_Implementations/avx2/crypto_kem/kyber1024/PQCkemKAT_3168.rsp (same SHA-256).
